newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks open one pct higher on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks open one pct higher on U.S. data.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index climbed one percent at Tuesday's open, boosted by favorable U.S. economic data. * Banks, Bre-X strengthen. * 14.5 million shares traded worth C$236 million.
Toronto's key stock index rose one percent at Tuesday's open, rallying on surprisingly weak U.S. employment cost numbers that eased inflation fears.

"We're soaring for now. Knee-jerk reaction to the data," said MMS International analyst Katherine Beattie. The U.S. employment cost index rose 0.6 percent in the first quarter, compared with economists' expectations of a 0.9 percent hike. Beattie said the data was so much weaker than forecast that investors are considering the possibility that the U.S. Federal Reserve will not have to hike short-term interest rates to quell growing inflationary pressures.
